title: Directory listing: Thornwood Seed Library
text: Thornwood Seed Library (Ashgrove). A community seed library operating since 2014. Lends open-pollinated vegetable and herb seed to members, who return seed saved from their own plots at the end of the season. Around forty varieties are available in a typical year. Funded through membership dues and a regional grant. Holds an annual seed swap each spring, open to non-members.
notes: Set A. Terse directory entry, deliberately the least discursive source.
